verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is an explicit visual automation builder supporting triggers (e.g., 'when a new deal is created'), record updates, notifications, and custom actions/agents (attio-docs-17,36,67,103,104,90,93), with webhooks and record-tab/action extensions reinforcing automation reach. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of building multi-step workflows in production, and more detail on task-creation as a native workflow action beyond record updates/notifications.
